pipeline: Filtered recovered C08 motion plus explicitly authored transitions, smooth constrained body-floor trajectory and kinematic support IK. No MotionBricks inference.
ground_policy: Support-specific flat sole anchors and fixed-length leg IK, coupled with smooth body-floor and reach constraints. Unsupported/roll phases release foot anchors. This is explicitly authored kinematic cleanup, not physical balance or a per-frame display grounding trick.

generator.provenance: Filtered recovered C08 motion plus explicitly authored transitions, smooth constrained body-floor trajectory and kinematic support IK. No MotionBricks inference.
limitations: Kinematic contact cleanup, not physical balance or self-collision
No hand/back pinning; roll and floor-support phases explicitly avoid foot locks
Authored pose-blend recovery is not captured stand-up motion
Core source timing retained; first/last10 horizontal root samples ease velocity without changing duration
Contact intervals are heuristic/action-specific, not sensor ground truth
Unreachable feet release instead of stretching limbs; releases reported
generator.core_foot_policy: Preserve cleaned leg rotations; no foot IK or pinning in the captured action
generator.authored_placement: Sequential left/right foot placement with9cm swing arcs during entry and recovery; one stance foot remains planted where its source/default pose is flat
generator.root_smoothing: Quadratic body-floor/reach fit with first/second difference penalties scaled by sample rate and its square
generator.historical_processing_hash_note: processing_script_sha256 identifies the source bytes used to generate this frozen output; reproduction_script_sha256 identifies later portable-root wrappers. Historical hashes are retained. Latest exact source snapshots are archived privately; older per-case source revisions may not be archived.

validation.scope: Actual GLB skinned sole corners and complete original skin, not solver-provided points. Full skin 120Hz plus support-boundary windows120Hz; soles and limb lengths120Hz. These sampled checks are not continuous collision or physical-balance proof. Jitter/support comparisons exclude authored transitions and holds; jitter is sampled at the original30Hz source times.

near_ground_motion_proxy.definition: Flat sole tilt<10deg, lowest corner between -2mm and35mm; horizontal center speed diagnostic, not independently labelled contact truth

unanchored_reach_projections.scope: Unanchored IK reach projections have requested and actual support weight zero; these are free-foot trajectory corrections, not broken planted contacts.

support_coverage.scope: Action support is separate from authored default holds. No requested action support means N/A, not proof of anchoring.
